traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `main.ts` makes the `rename` handler through `createRenameHandler()` when the script starts. It also shows what happens when the script renames trainer 1, and how the new name reaches the store through `saveTrainer()` and the rename log through `recordRename()`.
